recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the old Published issue against the current build by removing remaining misleading namespace terminology in token-related search documentation without changing mature token placeholder syntax or unrelated namespace uses.
issue_request: FHIR-3030 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and asked that search parameter documentation replace token and quantity forms using [namespace] with [system] and code/value wording where Identifier.value is involved.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 3077, corresponding to git-svn commit f97b8d01162ec11b7e54111d7e77f323b52df814. That commit changed source/search.html token syntax from [namespace]|[code] to [system]|[code] and changed the quantity syntax from [namespace] to [system], but current source still contained namespace wording in adjacent token text and the linked _filter token page.
additional_context: source/search.html is the active Search (RESTful API) source page and source/fhir.ini's search-rules note treats it as the summary table authority for search type updates. source/search_filter.html is an active _filter Parameter source page linked from source/search.html and source/exchanging.html. Later refactors made semantic consistency with system/code or system/value terminology more important than literal [code/value] placeholder syntax everywhere. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant discussion changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Changed source/search.html to say token searches operate on the system and code/value pair, changed the escaping note from namespace URI/code to system URI/code-value, and changed the boolean-token note to refer to the code system. Changed source/search_filter.html so token equality and predefined aliases use system/full system URI terminology. No quantity hunk was needed because current quantity syntax already uses [system].
source_changes: source/search.html: clarified token prose from a missing pair phrase to the system and code/value pair, changed namespace URI/code to system URI/code-value, and changed the boolean token code URL from namespace to code system.
source/search_filter.html: changed token comparison and predefined alias notes from namespace wording to system/full system URI wording.
